results.description:
What is the path to spiritual redemption? How can divine wisdom illuminate the soul’s journey to the Light?

Pistis Sophia is one of the most profound and mystical texts of the early Gnostic tradition. Attributed to the teachings of Jesus after his resurrection, this sacred work reveals esoteric dialogues with his disciples—exploring the soul’s ascent, the cosmic battle between Light and darkness, and the mysteries of divine knowledge and redemption.

Now available in a clear, modern translation, this edition brings the deep spiritual insights of Pistis Sophia to today’s listener, preserving its mysticism while offering clarity and inspiration.

What you'll discover inside:
The Journey of the Soul – Follow Pistis Sophia’s ascent from the lower realms of darkness to the Light aboveThe Mysteries of the Higher Realms – Jesus’ teachings on divine hierarchies, cosmic structure, and spiritual awakeningRedemption and Divine Wisdom – Lessons on faith, knowledge, and the transformative power of spiritual perseveranceA Window into Gnostic Thought – Insight into early Christian mysticism, theology, and the soul’s divine purpose
Whether you’re a spiritual seeker, a student of ancient texts, or exploring Gnostic wisdom for the first time, Pistis Sophia offers timeless guidance for the soul’s journey toward redemption and enlightenment.

Begin your journey today—and uncover the mystical path to divine Light.
